Lawn Mowing in Mill Park for Overgrown Lawns

Overgrown, patchy or simply out of hand? We cut it back under control, clean up the edges, then keep it looking sharp with regular mowing.

Get a QuoteCall 0459 960 501

Written by Dan, qualified horticulturalist and founder of The Mowersaurus

Lawn mowing Mill Park

Overgrown lawn? We'll bring it back

Life gets busy, it rains for a fortnight, or you've just moved in, and the lawn gets away from you. Our lawn mowing in Mill Park is built for exactly that. We take long, overgrown grass back down in stages so the turf isn't scalped or shocked, then edge the paths, driveway and garden beds so the whole yard looks cared for again.

Once it's under control, most clients keep it that way with regular mowing. Plenty of people then move onto one of our lawn care programs, which add fertilising, weed and grub control and soil care to the mow.

Because our team are horticulturalists, we'll also tell you what we see. If your lawn has a grub problem, compacted soil or a weed takeover, you'll know, along with what it would take to fix it.

What's included

  • Overgrown lawn cuts, done in stages where needed
  • Mowing at the right height for your grass type
  • Edging along paths, driveways and garden beds
  • Line trimming around fences, trees and tight spots
  • Clippings blown off hard surfaces
  • Regular ongoing mowing to keep it under control

FAQ

Lawn Mowing FAQs

How overgrown is too overgrown?

Nothing's too overgrown. For very long grass we cut in stages so the lawn isn't scalped, and we clean up all the clippings.

How often should my lawn be mowed?

During the growing season most lawns in Mill Park need mowing every one to three weeks, depending on the grass and how fast it's growing. Most of our regular clients are on a two-weekly, three-weekly or monthly schedule.

Do you mow nature strips?

Yes. Nature strips are mowed and edged along the footpath and kerb as part of the job.

Do you mow commercial properties?

Yes. We're fully insured and look after commercial, strata and body corporate lawns as well as homes.
